minimalCompletenessFindings: Eleven of 25 submissions pass under the published arithmetic. S41c18bfd4f earns 7.5 with a symbolic momentum difference, Δp/(3 s), and a correct direction. S0de4cfc60e reaches exactly 8 by also stating −4, even without a force unit. S41d4e7224e reaches 8.5 with −4 N while still giving no numerical momentum change. The interval criterion has a parallel gap: a correct numerical Δp, a general quotient with no numerical duration shown, −4 N, and a correct direction can earn 3 + 2.5 + 3 = 8.5. By contrast, explicitly using the endpoint time scores 7, and multiplying by the correct duration scores 7.5. A correct signed calculation with an omitted or maintained wrong direction interpretation scores 7.5. Formula-only and qualitative-only work each score 3. A single exact numerical quotient with a unit and direction earns 10. The constant-force and endpoint-force assertions each leave 8.5, while a complete answer that omits this optional discussion earns 10.
